# Pixel Library Desk

A fully offline, accessible pixel-art styled library desk app built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- Lists 6 built-in books with title, author, and availability status.
- Check out or return any book with a single button.
- Filter to show only available books.
- Live checked-out count that updates instantly.
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus, hover, and pressed states.
- Responsive layout that works from 360px wide.

## Files

- `index.html` – Page structure and content.
- `styles.css` – Pixel-art theme, responsive layout, and interactive states.
- `app.js` – Book data, rendering, filtering, and event handling.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, build step, or network connection required.

## Notes

- All state is in-memory; refreshing resets the collection.
- Uses `[hidden] { display: none !important; }` to ensure the filter always hides checked-out books correctly.
